mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO gamification_event (event_type, source_key, user_id, book_id, occurred_at, local_date, payload_hash, payload, status, attempt, policy_version) VALUES (#{event.eventType}, #{event.sourceKey}, #{event.userId}, #{event.bookId}, #{event.occurredAt}, #{event.localDate}, #{event.payloadHash}, #{event.payloadJson}, 'PENDING', 0, #{event.policyVersion})
mapper.select: SELECT id, event_type AS eventType, source_key AS sourceKey, user_id AS userId, book_id AS bookId, occurred_at AS occurredAt, local_date AS localDate, payload_hash AS payloadHash, payload AS payloadJson, status, attempt, processed_at AS processedAt, error_message AS errorMessage, policy_version AS policyVersion, version, create_time AS createTime FROM gamification_event WHERE source_key = #{sourceKey} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, event_type AS eventType, source_key AS sourceKey, user_id AS userId, book_id AS bookId, occurred_at AS occurredAt, local_date AS localDate, payload_hash AS payloadHash, payload AS payloadJson, status, attempt, processed_at AS processedAt, error_message AS errorMessage, policy_version AS policyVersion, version, create_time AS createTime FROM gamification_event WHERE id = #{eventId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE gamification_event SET status = #{status}, processed_at = #{processedAt}, error_message = NULL, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{eventId} AND status = 'PENDING' AND version = #{expectedVersion}
mapper.select: SELECT quest_code AS questCode, event_type AS eventType, period_type AS periodType, target_count AS targetCount, name_key AS nameKey, sort_no AS sortNo, active FROM quest_definition WHERE event_type = #{eventType} AND active = 1 ORDER BY sort_no ASC, quest_code ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO user_quest_progress (user_id, quest_code, period_key, current_count, target_count) VALUES (#{userId}, #{questCode}, #{periodKey}, 0, #{targetCount})
mapper.select: SELECT id, campaign_code AS campaignCode, start_at AS startAt, end_at AS endAt, status, policy_version AS policyVersion FROM quest_campaign WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND start_at <= #{observedAt} AND end_at > #{observedAt} ORDER BY start_at DESC, campaign_code ASC LIMIT 2

SELECT q.quest_code AS questCode, q.period_type AS periodType, CASE q.period_type WHEN 'DAILY' THEN #{dailyKey} WHEN 'WEEKLY' THEN #{weeklyKey} ELSE 'ALL' END AS periodKey, COALESCE(p.target_count, q.target_count) AS targetCount, q.name_key AS nameKey, q.sort_no AS sortNo, COALESCE(p.current_count, 0) AS currentCount, p.completed_at AS completedAt, c.id AS claimId, c.create_time AS claimedAt, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(r.amount) FROM quest_reward r WHERE r.quest_code = q.quest_code AND r.campaign_code = #{campaignCode} AND r.reward_type = 'EXP'), (SELECT SUM(r.amount) FROM quest_reward r WHERE r.quest_code = q.quest_code AND r.campaign_code = 'DEFAULT' AND r.reward_type = 'EXP'), 0) AS expReward, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(r.amount) FROM quest_reward r WHERE r.quest_code = q.quest_code AND r.campaign_code = #{campaignCode} AND r.reward_type = 'TICKET'), (SELECT SUM(r.amount) FROM quest_reward r WHERE r.quest_code = q.quest_code AND r.campaign_code = 'DEFAULT' AND r.reward_type = 'TICKET'), 0) AS ticketReward FROM quest_definition q LEFT JOIN user_quest_progress p ON p.user_id = #{userId} AND p.quest_code = q.quest_code AND p.period_key = CASE q.period_type WHEN 'DAILY' THEN #{dailyKey} WHEN 'WEEKLY' THEN #{weeklyKey} ELSE 'ALL' END LEFT JOIN quest_claim c ON c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.quest_code = q.quest_code AND c.period_key = CASE q.period_type WHEN 'DAILY' THEN #{dailyKey} WHEN 'WEEKLY' THEN #{weeklyKey} ELSE 'ALL' END WHERE q.active = 1 ORDER BY q.sort_no ASC, q.quest_code ASC

mapper.update: UPDATE gamification_profile SET total_exp = #{totalExp}, level = #{level}, frame_code = #{frameCode}, version = version + 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND version = #{expectedVersion}
